metadata.description: Start a foreground loopback Task Engine, optionally with its HTTP Web UI.

options: --ipfs-gateway-url <HTTP(S) Gateway base URL; required from an enabled source>
standalone.precedence: Explicit CLI > explicit YAML/JSON file > pguide USER config.jsonc > defaults. Project service settings are never read.
standalone.paths: Effective CWD is --cwd or process CWD for both entrypoints and --config. Each file's paths are relative to that file; CLI paths are relative to effective CWD.
standalone.validation: Invalid or unreadable global configuration/settings registry emits a warning and the entire global layer is ignored. Explicit file and CLI layers must validate even when overridden. Complete settings (including uiOptions) replace, never deep merge. No executable config or environment service overrides.
standalone.isolation: --no-global-config skips the user main file, including top-level discovery and user commandDirectories. PATH and project discovery remain available.
standalone.security: No token; fixed loopback only (localhost becomes 127.0.0.1; ::1 supported). Caller local-cli is limited to the configured scope. Host/Origin/fetch-site, GET/POST and JSON writes are checked. Do not expose through a proxy. Other local users/processes are not isolated.
standalone.lifecycle: Foreground only. Stops only this invocation's Engine/UI on SIGINT/SIGTERM. Never starts, stops or manages Kubo. No UI unless --ui. Old .mjs configs must be manually migrated. Gateway-only: an explicit URL is required (no credentials/query/fragment); no default node or public Gateway. Base paths are appended with /ipfs/{cid}?format=raw. Raw blocks only, no redirects, 2 MiB/block and 30 s/read. No service RPC or transport selection/fallback; author publishing/pinning is unchanged.
